I drew the canopy chart and rendered it on the fake data, and you chose to go back to Idli. I haven't looked at the rendered picture myself, only confirmed it rendered without errors.

- **How it counts:** only trees marked Y or N for canopy. Blank or other values are left out of the share. If there are more than 15 transects, it shows the 15 with the highest share. If there is no data, it draws "No data".
